headline: Nigeria Power Minister Joseph Tegbe Outlines Grid Stabilisation Roadmap
summary: Nigeria's Minister of Power Joseph Tegbe unveiled a strategic roadmap designed to stabilise the national electricity transmission grid, expand wheeling capacity, and attract new investments to resolve persistent sector deficits.
why: Inadequate power grid infrastructure is a primary bottleneck for Nigerian industrial production and commercial business activity.

impacts.name: Nigerian Utilities
impacts.why: Transmission expansion plans aim to reduce grid collapses and encourage private capital injection.
